1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js — constrains n to the inclusive range [min, max] using nested Math calls.
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js — divides by 1024 iteratively through units (B, KB, MB, GB) and formats with one decimal place (no decimals for bytes).
3. **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js — lowercases, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, and strips non-alphanumeric characters except dashes in a single chain.

All are exported and follow the project's code style.
